title: Fixed Split Nib and Posted Cap Fountain Pen
description: One wholly newly authored complete fountain-pen-style exterior with its cap fixed over the rear end and its blunt nib exposed. A continuous turned-looking barrel narrows into one separate complete grip section. One thick curved tapered nib plate has a true central open slit widening into an expanded vent opening, with two finite blunt tip branches; a complete dark feed-shaped support remains behind the nib. One deep thick closed-bottom cap surrounds the rear barrel, with a proud metal-look mouth band and one continuous exterior pocket clip. The whole pen is displayed upright on the finite closed cap end, no separate stand. Unlike the old utility knife it has no long body slider or sliding flat extension through a front collar; unlike a drawing-machine blunt cylindrical pen stem it includes the complete nib/grip/barrel/posted cap/clip organization. All vertices newly authored, no old blade or pen component imported or extracted. Three opaque PBR roles, metres Z up and centred ground datum, one complete model zero scenes. Static stationery exterior only: no writing, ink reservoir or flow, nib flex, sharp edge, cap motion, pocket/hand fit, manufacture, operating instructions or safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.
